FOCAL LENGTH from the negative, not the picture: four points cannot separate focal length from distance at this size (a free fit runs off to an orthographic camera), so f is set from the format, a 3 1/4 x 4 1/4 in. plate (the collection's) on a 5-6 1/2 in. lens, 360-470 px across the 308 px print; 420 px is used, and the fit was repeated at 380 and 460.
